text:
Platinum Price in 2002
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2002, the LBMA platinum price rose 31.4% between 2002-01-31 ($455) and 2002-12-30 ($598). The highest sampled price was $598 in December and the lowest was $455 in January. The mean of these observations was $543. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
